difficulty.consumer: DifficultyButtonController.SetButtonImage 0x382a414 writes the same lookup result to UISprite 11, cover UISprite 8 and UIButton 10 normalSprite.
difficulty.lookup: DifficultyUtility.GetDifficultyButtonSpriteName 0x33a70a0 lowercases the difficulty key, looks up the prefix, and appends on for state 0 or off for state 1.
difficulty.source: difficulty-native.json and ScriptString metadata; prefab serialized fields include 102x102 sprites and 92x92 collider.
difficulty.boundary: The editor selects a chart difficulty directly; original account unlocks, first-look icon and cached song selection are not imported.
